# Holk and Zis Dynamics (HZD)
[color=#999999][italic]"Hi"[/italic][/color] [color=#999999][italic]- Placeholder Dude[/italic][/color]
Holk and Zis Dynamics are a research and defense contractor.
Holk Brewer and Zis Cheliceroit, a male human and arachnid respectively are the Co-founders of one of the leading researchers of plastitanium material science, discovering new alloys and methods of forging and milling plastitanium to bend to their will. Their beginnings are humble, working in the neighboring sector as frontiersman, Holk being a salvager with a background in engineering, and Zis being a researcher of anomalies with a short stint working as sector security, after spending a few shifts working together they spent some time discussing their gripes with what gear they could access and its shortcomings, ranging from storage issues to simple durability issues with fragile parts. Soon they had decided to put their minds together to try and fill these gaps and fix these issues, but they had discovered an issue, the materials they had access to were not up to the task, so they did research and settled on plastitanium for its neigh unrivaled toughness and stability.
In time they had gone from a simple duo producing their own arms and armor out of a personal ship to taking custom orders from friends, then friends of friends. With ever ramping orders they had to hire staff to assist and construct more ships dedicated to specific tasks.
This all lead to the fleet based company that now exists today, supplying the TFA and TDF with arms, armor, and materials for a.. almost reasonable price. The fleet is comically massive but mostly consists of research, salvage, and manufactory vessels, though their escort ships are no slouches and are known for driving off pirates and the syndicate remnants with alarming efficiency, keeping their profits and investments safe. HZD is mostly uninvolved in direct combat if they can help it, lurking on the outskirts of the sector and sending the occassional armed and escorted merchant ship or cargo ship to either supply mercenaries or deliver equipment to TDF facilities.
More recently, the TDF had taken a lucrative deal with HZD, supplying blueprints for certain arms and armor to registered mercs in exchange for royalties (sending the research data to HZD for analysis) or even having the merc or TDF member send the manufactured item back to HZD when finished being used, either to be put to use or for analysis on equipment wear and performance.
